messages:
alex: quick async standup — onboarding update and quick asks

alex: what I did: deployed llama3-smallq v1.2 to staging, ran the nightly evals + promptset 'cust-support-short' (50 cases). saw a ~4% drop in helpfulness vs baseline on that promptset. also exercised batching at batch_size=8 for latency profile.

alex: blockers: quant profile 'q4_0-fast' fails p50 SLO when batch_size > 4 (spikes to ~180ms). unsure if kernel selection or config. prompt tweak PR is ready but want to be sure regressions aren't model-side.

maria: can you paste the eval summary and the diff for the promptset? curious which examples regressed.

alex: sure — pasted quick summary from eval-bot below:
```
(eval-bot) promptset: cust-support-short
baseline helpfulness: 0.88
llama3-smallq-v1.2 helpfulness: 0.844 (-0.036)
regressions: 6/50 examples, mostly fallback to generic apology pattern
latency p50 (batch=4): 95ms -> 110ms
latency p50 (batch=8): 120ms -> 180ms
```

sam: @alex I can take the quant config and repro the kernel selection locally. do you have the failing command and the model flags you used?

alex: running: `redwood run --model llama3-smallq --quant q4_0-fast --batch 8 --seq 512 --profile latency`
also tried `--kernel auto` and `--kernel cuda_fast` with similar spikes.

lila: have we seen the apology fallback before on this promptset? could be prompt mismatch after tokenization changes. @maria any sign it's tokenization drift?

maria: quick scan — 4 of the 6 regressed examples are non-english punctuation (Spanish/Portuguese names). maybe tokenizer edge-case. i'll run tokenized diffs.

jin: fyi earlier I hit a KV-cache warmup bug that sometimes returns truncated sentences when ctx len ~> 320 and tokenizer falls back. could be related. tagging here since language mix + kv behavior could amplify the regression.

alex: good catch @jin — i'll repro with the same seq lengths and mixed-language cases.

sam: I'll repro the quant / kernel path and post logs here. if it's kernel, we'll open an eng-runtime bug. if quant, we'll try q4_0-slow profile to compare quality delta.

maria: action items then:
- alex: repro with seq=320/512, attach raw outputs for the 6 regressed cases (due EOD)
- sam: reproduce kernel/quant perf locally and report (if >30% delta open infra bug)
- jin: share KV-cache repro steps if you can (or a tiny snippet)
- lila: run tokenization diff on the 6 cases and post deltas

lila: quick note — if tokenization is the culprit, a small prompt anchor (explicit few-shot example) restored behavior in prior runs. could be a quick mitigation.

alex: thanks folks — i'll post the EOD dump. adding label `onboard/llama3-smallq/regression` and opening a tracking thread. ping me if you need SSH to staging nodes. :thumbsup:

eval-bot: nightly-evals uploaded: https://internal-redwood/evals/1723456789-cust-support-short — summary CSV + diffs attached.

maria: acked, will follow up once token diffs are in. :eyes:

sam: starting repro now, will report within 2 hours.

alex: closing this async note, will update thread when I have the EOD artifacts. cheers.
